subject: Continuous frame joints: Bell 407GX, vehicle trim and architectural paths
cause: Independently capped rods or beams met at center points, leaving mismatched outer edges at bends.
correction: Sweep each continuous path through shared mitered corner rings. Cap only open ends; close loops without duplicate end caps. Preserve independent members and detail-level subdivision limits.

scope.method: Parse every JS/TS source; inventory rod/tube/beam/cylinder calls inside loops. Separately inventory Python geometry call sites for manual review. Candidate lists are not a visual acceptance claim.
scope.visualReview: All 43 rebuilt cockpit overview renders inspected; Bell 407 close-up, Volvo V70 exterior, Winnebago interior, Gros Horloge clock trim, Torun timber frames and Grande Arche roof rail views inspected. This is not a visual acceptance of every model or every candidate.

jointGeometryTests.cases: Miter widths; open and closed manifold edges; reverse winding; duplicate stations; bounded acute joins; invalid reversals; rectangular sections; Float32 normals.

sourceReproduction: Barolo source reproduction in runtime tests
verification.sourceAndRuntimeHashes: All entries below verified through inspectAsset; architecture includes four runtime LODs per model.

remainingReview.status: Candidate inventory, not confirmed defects. Custom generators still require individual review before conversion.
